scope: Every existing nonpublic observation property of the unmanaged thread-confined typed pool, through the actual friend assembly. Private observations are not package-user APIs or borrowing authority. Preparation adds physical pages without a generation, root or quarantine bank.
consistency: Read on the construction thread at known mutation boundaries, including that thread's entered initializer/callback. Lifecycle and metadata probes do not themselves validate payload authority. Segment ordinal capture validates owner thread even after retirement/disposal; it allocates a detached numeric copy. No concurrent-snapshot claim.
resetPolicy: Actual current gauges follow slab transitions. Metadata bank capacities remain allocated after trim/terminal native cleanup. Physical acquisition ordinals are monotonically checked, survive reuse, disappear on physical free and are not reset by process metrics epochs. A zero-length record has no physical ordinal.
unreviewedScope: Thirteen typed pool observation properties and their true absent-bank invariants only. Other private models, complete demo-role and public API/lifecycle inventories, all feature performance and final native/release evidence remain required. No packaged private access is claimed.

fields.name: CurrentLifecycle
fields.definition: Actual Active, Returned by coordinator retirement, or Disposed after cleanup; numeric observation does not authorize renting.

fields.name: CurrentAllocationRecordCountForTest
fields.definition: Actual occupied records including initializing and zero-length leases; returning or rollback debits once. This is not a physical segment or page count.
fields.overflow: Bounded by checked slab-bank capacity and valid slot publication.

fields.name: CurrentInitializationCountForTest
fields.definition: Scan of actual Initializing slab states within the allocated active prefix. Successful publication and exception rollback remove initialization state, not retained backing.
fields.overflow: Nonnegative subset of the bounded active slab prefix.
fields.allocation: None; derived at observation, no extra per-initializer counter.

fields.name: CurrentGenerationActiveOperationsForTest
fields.definition: Actual sum of slab BorrowCount plus one per Initializing state. Nested borrows and an initializer plus a different live lease count separately. The legacy name does not imply this owner has generational storage.
fields.overflow: Checked observation sum; cannot wrap into a valid smaller count.
fields.allocation: None; scan of existing state, not a new hot-path counter.

fields.name: CurrentBankCapacitiesForTest
fields.definition: Slabs and AvailableSlabs both describe the SAME slab array capacity because free links are embedded in it; do not add them as independent memory. Bumps is genuinely zero. OwnerSegments is the actual page array length in prepared mode, zero for ordinary direct slabs. Trim does not shrink these managed arrays.
fields.allocation: None; value tuple copies existing lengths.

fields.name: CurrentReferenceRootCountForTest
fields.definition: Invariant zero because T is unmanaged and there is no reference-slot root table. Owner/control metadata references are not payload roots.
fields.overflow: Invariant absence, not a suppressed varying counter.

fields.name: QuarantinedSegmentCountForTest
fields.definition: Invariant zero: this nongenerational pool rejects cleanup with live leases rather than quarantining banks. Coordinator retirement is a gate transition, not a quarantined generation.

fields.name: QuarantinedGenerationCountForTest
fields.definition: Invariant zero because no generational quarantine collection exists, including during entered callbacks and terminal cleanup.

fields.name: RetiredGenerationCountForTest
fields.definition: Invariant zero: public Retire requires no live lease/initializer/borrow. Its Returned gate may still own storage but is not a generations-waiting-for-drain bank.

fields.name: QuarantineCapacityForTest
fields.definition: Invariant zero allocated capacity; no quarantine array is reserved or hidden in slab/page metadata.

fields.name: CurrentScopeEpochForTest
fields.definition: Invariant zero because the typed pool has no scoped generation. Private scope mutation hook explicitly refuses to invent it; actual per-slot lease tokens separately reject stale aliases.
fields.overflow: No scope domain to increment or wrap.

fields.name: GenerationCounterForTest
fields.definition: Invariant zero in the single-lifetime typed owner. Physical allocation ordinals and lease tokens are distinct real identities, not substitute generation counters.
fields.overflow: No generation domain; absent-generation fault hook rejects.

fields.name: CurrentSegmentOrdinalsForTest
fields.definition: Fresh detached sorted array of currently retained physical ordinary slabs, or prepared pages in acquisition order. Logical zero-length records have no ordinal; slot reuse adds no acquisition and a freed/reacquired block gets a new checked ordinal. Copy mutation cannot alter owner state.
fields.overflow: Physical ordinal allocation is checked before publication; capture cannot invent an unavailable identity.
fields.allocation: One numeric array per observation, including empty observation; not a no-allocation public capture API or hot-loop telemetry. Owner thread is checked before allocation.
